subject.title: perf: avoid event-loop stall during embedded_run bootstrap-context

question: Should OpenClaw replace Node's glob dependency contract with this repository-owned cooperative walker and permit event-loop interleaving between bootstrap hook handlers?
rationale: The reviewed implementation has no concrete defect, but these permanent compatibility and session-context contracts require human ownership rather than automated acceptance.

options.title: Adopt with owner sign-off
options.body: Accept the contracts after supported-platform parity and a full embedded-run liveness check on the exact head.

options.title: Split the direct fix
options.body: Land asynchronous descriptor reads and diagnostics while deferring the custom walker and hook scheduling.

options.title: Use a narrower approach
options.body: Pause this PR and pursue an upstream, library, or runner-level cooperative solution with less semantic ownership.

recommendation.title: Adopt with owner sign-off
recommendation.body: Accept the contracts after supported-platform parity and a full embedded-run liveness check on the exact head.
